summary: Battery firmware flash mismatch after depot repair causes ACPI fallback and stalls Autopilot provisioning
description: Issue summary: Several recently returned laptops from depot repair fail Windows Autopilot provisioning because the OS falls back to ACPI battery emulation. Impact: Affected units do not pass Intune compliance checks and remain in a provisioning 'Waiting on device' state; staging pool throughput reduced by ~18% while units are quarantined. Environment: Corporate depot-repaired Dell and HP devices, corp-imaging lab (staging-us-east), Autopilot + Intune + ConfigMgr hybrid enrollment. Steps to reproduce: 1) Apply depot firmware flash image to battery controller during repair (DEPOTFW v1.3.2). 2) Re-image using corp task sequence with latest image (Win11 22H2, corp baseline). 3) On first boot, device reports battery as ACPI 'Unknown' and Windows reports 'Battery information unavailable' in Device Manager. 4) Autopilot enrolment triggers but device stalls on 'Applying device settings' and fails compliance checks. Observed behavior: Battery reports manufacturer id mismatch and Windows falls back to ACPI battery driver; WMI battery classes return inconsistent charge/discharge data. Device does not reach 'Azure AD joined, Intune enrolled' state. Expected behavior: Battery firmware flash should be transparent; OS should report valid battery telemetry and allow Autopilot to complete. Logs/diagnostics collected: eventvwr System and Application logs, MDM enrollment traces, Intune device status snapshots, dump of WMI battery class output, depot repair manifest with battery FW version. One affected serial: SN-REDACTED-001. Relevant artifacts uploaded to internal SMB path and linked below.
investigation_notes: Initial triage by support: reproduced failure on two lab units. Hypothesis: depot FW flasher writes incorrect EEDATA battery descriptor causing OS battery driver to choose ACPI fallback. Hardware team confirmed depot tool EXE used v1.3.2 which has new checksum behavior. Imaging team: task sequence does not reflash battery controller after re-imaging which leaves mismatch. SRE: Intune failure correlates with WMI battery class errors; compliance policy checks for battery presence/health which fails when telemetry blank. Temporary experiment: re-run depot flasher with legacy compatibility flag and re-image -> Autopilot completes. Evidence: mjr-battery-dump-2026-03-11.log, wmi-battery-output.txt attached in artifacts. Priority escalated due to impact on staging capacity.
